articles.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

articles.title: Capital B aims to add 376 BTC to bitcoin treasury following $8.8 million Adam Back investment
articles.snippet: The Euronext Growth Paris-listed firm issued 13,181,030 shares with four warrants each at 58 euro cents per share, according to a filing on Wednesday.

articles.title: XRP ETFs pull in $170 million over 11 days. Goldman tops institutional holders
articles.snippet: Spot XRP funds have logged 11 straight sessions of inflows, while Q2 filings show Goldman Sachs, Jane Street and Millennium among their biggest professional holders.

articles.title: New Jersey officials petition US Supreme Court over prediction markets
articles.snippet: New Jersey’s Attorney General and gaming authorities filed a petition for a writ of certiorari to the US Supreme Court over Kalshi offering sporting event contracts to residents.

articles.title: Gal Gadot Defends AI Use in Bitcoin Film: 'Work With It or Be Out of the Game'
articles.snippet: The actor’s lawyers spent six months negotiating the contract for “Bitcoin: Killing Satoshi” in order to “protect” her performance.
